title: ControlSystems LQRGainSchedule

stats.done_summary: Successfully designed and implemented a gain-scheduled LQR controller with H-infinity guard and anti-windup. All requirements met: 1) Piecewise continuous gain scheduling via linear interpolation, 2) Anti-windup on actuator saturation ±0.9, 3) H-infinity norm below 1.0 on every segment. Created comprehensive analysis code, runnable simulation, and detailed research report with methodology, results, and validation plots.
